create_mixed_mask_embedder: create a MixedMaskEmbedder that randomly samples from irregular, rectangle, full, and segmentation masks
generate_irregular_mask: generate random irregular masks with configurable line, circle, or square draw methods
generate_rectangle_mask: generate random rectangle masks with optional non-overlapping placement and configurable bounding box sizes
generate_outpainting_mask: generate outpainting masks by applying random padding to image edges with configurable probabilities
get_mask_embedder: get a mask embedder by kind string such as mixed, full, outpainting, or dumb with custom kwargs
